US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks | BBC News
recentItems.description:
Iran and the US have traded strikes after American forces attacked two rocket launchers on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz.
 
The first known US strikes on Iran since late July killed two people and injured two others, according to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, which vowed "response and punishment".
 
US Central Command said it had taken "limited, precise action" against "minelaying forces posing an imminent threat in the Strait of Hormuz".

recentItems.title: More than 900 people killed in Nepal-Tibet flood | BBC News
recentItems.description:
The number of people missing in Nepal after the massive flash flood on Wednesday has risen to 4,247- with at least 903 people known to have died.
 
The number of missing is a sharp rise from 2,502, which was announced on Sunday. Of those missing, 3,655 are Nepali citizens, with 592 foreigners unaccounted for.
 
In Tibet, the official death toll is 16, with 546 reported missing, according to Chinese state media.

Seven killed and 23 missing after boat capsizes off northern Cyprus | BBC News
recentItems.description:
Seven people have died after a passenger boat capsized near northern Cyprus.
 
Search and rescue operations are under way to find 23 people missing, said Ünal Üstel, prime minister of the self-declared Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus.
 
He says 267 people were on board the vessel when it capsized, and 237 have been rescued.
 
The boat left from the northern Cypriot port of Kyrenia at 11:58 local time (09:58 BST) and officials said it capsized around four nautical miles into its journey to Turkey.
